case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for the continued cooperation. We value Ravensteiner as a partner and would like to build on it with more planning security for both sides.

Our data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

With that in mind, we would like to offer a larger binding volume and a longer contract term, which gives you secure planning and gives us reliable supply:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our offer stands at a price of €33.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.80 per unit. For this option, a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months applies. We accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract in exchange for maintaining the lead time at 54 days. Under these terms, we propose a unit price of EUR 31.80.

We note your historical data. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Which volume can you commit to?

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Zellner,

Thank you for your clear final offer and for checking the data we shared. We understand your position and appreciate the straightforward way you have set out the terms.

We are glad to accept your alternative proposal as offered, with the longer lead time. It gives both sides the volume and contract security we were looking for:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.80; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.

We look forward to continuing the cooperation on this basis.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your acceptance of our pricing and the adjustment to a 56-day lead time. The terms of a price of €31.80 per unit for a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 36 months are acceptable. 

Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. We can accept your terms and await your order. We will proceed with the contract on this basis.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
